title: 5 Pickups Actually Worth Buying in 2027 (And the Warning for Each)
description:
Five pickup trucks that the data says are worth buying in twenty twenty-seven. One keeps eighty percent of its value after five years. One starts under thirty thousand dollars and has a hybrid engine. One was named first for dependability by one study, and second by another. And one has a catch that most buyers never hear about. Here are the trucks worth buying, with the real numbers and the real warnings.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
2:00 1. Toyota Tacoma
3:40 2. Ford Maverick Hybrid
5:12 3. Ford F-150
7:00 4. Ram 1500
9:10 5. Heavy-duty trucks
14:16 The truck we left out
20:43 What to check before you buy in 2027

Sources:
There are a lot of lists of the best trucks, and most of them are opinions. This one is different, because every pick comes with numbers from a published source, and every pick also comes with a warning. A truck that is worth buying for one buyer can be the wrong truck for another. So for each one, we will tell you who it is for, who should look somewhere else, and what to check.
